{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Cleaning droid 397-10B'' has detected a ''UPD''&mdash;an unexplained piece of debris&mdash;in ''utility tunnel 4048''.''"<br />"''Probably nothing, but protocol demands we immediately dispatch&mdash;a security team to check on the vault!|Two [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]]|<ref name="The Professional!" />}}
'''397-10B''' was a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droid]] inside [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Katalla casino|casino's]] underground facility on [[Katalla]]. During [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Mission to Katalla|mission]] to destroy the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] vault, 397-10B was alerted to their presence when he found an unexplained piece of debris in one of the tunnels of the facility.
